summaries: A SEC Form 10-Q quarterly report for AGEAGLE AERIAL SYSTEMS INC. for the period ended March 31, 2024. Relevant to the task: The Condensed Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows (Page 7) reports "Net cash provided by financing activities" as $1,641,894 for the three months ended March 31, 2024. This net amount stems primarily from the sale of preferred stock ($950,000), conversion of warrants ($497,701), and other short-term loans ($514,000), offset by issuance costs and COVID loan repayments. As a single data point, it provides AgEagle’s financing cash flow figure for the quarter, which must be compared against other documents to determine the highest amount.
